item.description:
• Fixed a regression from 1.5.2: the "Manually Installed" section and the "Move to Homebrew" button could disappear entirely when none of your apps happened to be behind their Homebrew cask version. All manually-installed apps are listed again
  • The "Move to Homebrew" picker now warns and disables selection for apps that are already ahead of their Homebrew cask version, since adopting them would actually replace the newer app with an older one
